nodes.name: Rapikan dan Tandai Proses Macet

parameters.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN
 current_setting('transaction_read_only')='off'
 AND (SELECT setting::integer FROM pg_settings WHERE name='statement_timeout') BETWEEN 1 AND 3000
 AND (SELECT setting::integer FROM pg_settings WHERE name='lock_timeout') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND NOT rolsuper AND rolconnlimit BETWEEN 1 AND 6)
 THEN casir_control.maintenance()
 ELSE jsonb_build_object('allowed',false,'httpStatus',503,'blocked',true,'reason','UNSAFE_CONTROL_ROLE')
 END AS status;

nodes.notes: Credential casir_automation wajib. Role statement_timeout 3s, lock_timeout 1s. Tidak mengirim ulang atau mengakses POS.

parameters.jsCode: if ($json.status?.blocked === true || Number($json.status?.needsReview)>0) throw new Error("CASIR_REQUIRES_REVIEW: cek metadata kontrol; jangan retry pesan otomatis."); return [{json:{healthy:true}}];

parameters.content:
## NONAKTIF sampai database kontrol siap
Setiap menit menandai lease >180 detik sebagai REVIEW/UNKNOWN dan mengunci admission baru. Tidak mengulang AI/query/kirim. Retensi teks 1 jam, metadata 7 hari. Error hanya menunjukkan perlu pemeriksaan; bukan notifikasi eksternal. Baca resilience/OPERATIONS.txt untuk membuka penguncian setelah worker betul-betul berhenti.
